create_runner_subclass: create a python class that inherits from Runner and implements run, save_state, and load_state methods
test_mockrunner_save_load: test MockRunner by creating an instance, calling save_state to write mock_state.json, then load_state to restore values
use_preemptablemixin_for_checkpointing: use PreemptableMixin with a Runner subclass to add STOPFAIR preemption detection and atomic checkpoint saving
implement_save_simulation_state: implement save_simulation_state and load_simulation_state in a PreemptableMixin subclass to persist domain-specific checkpoint data
handle_stopfairdetected_exception: handle the StopfairDetected exception raised when a STOPFAIR sentinel file is detected during a run
